title.zh: 修订第2957号共和国法（即《授予Jose M. F. Belo在卡皮斯省与Roxas市范围内经营电话通信系统特许权》）第7条的法案
title.en: An Act to Amend Section Seven of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-Nine Hundred and Fifty-Seven, Entitled “An Act to Grant Telephone Communication System Franchise to Jose M. F. Belo Within the Province of Capiz and Roxas City”
title.orig: An Act to Amend Section Seven of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-Nine Hundred and Fifty-Seven, Entitled “An Act to Grant Telephone Communication System Franchise to Jose M. F. Belo Within the Province of Capiz and Roxas City”

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1962/ra_3483_1962.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section seven of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-nine hundred and fifty-seven is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 7. In consideration of the franchise and rights hereby granted, the grantee, his successors or assigns shall, during the life of the franchise, pay to the Treasurer of the Philippines each year, within ten days after the audit and approval of the accounts as prescribed in Section six of this Act, a tax of one per centum of all gross receipts of the telephone business transacted under this franchise by the grantee, his successors or assigns, and the said tax shall be in lieu of all taxes, fees, charges or duties of any kind, nature or description, levied, established or collected by any municipal, city, provincial or national authority."

This Act shall take effect as of June nineteen, nineteen hundred sixty.
Approved: June 16, 1962.
